# signoz_ingestion_key (Data Source)

Fetches an ingestion key from SigNoz using its ID.

~> **Note:** The `value` attribute may be masked or empty when read via the data source, as the API may not return the full key value on GET requests.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

data "signoz_ingestion_key" "existing" {
  id = "key-abc-123"
}

output "ingestion_key" {
  value     = data.signoz_ingestion_key.existing
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the ingestion key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the ingestion key.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration time of the ingestion key.
- `ingestion_url` (String) The ingestion URL associated with this key.
- `name` (String) Name of the ingestion key.
- `rate_limits` (Attributes) Rate limits for the ingestion key. (see below for nested schema)
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the ingestion key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the ingestion key.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The ingestion key value. May be masked or empty when read via data source.

### Nested Schema for `rate_limits`

Read-Only:

- `day_limit` (Number) Maximum number of requests per day.
- `second_limit` (Number) Maximum number of requests per second.
